newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria seizes two tonnes of hashish.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria seizes two tonnes of hashish.

text.p: Bulgarian police said on Tuesday they had seized two tonnes (4,410 pounds) of hashish at the Kulata check point on the Greek border as a result of stricter controls on cargo movements through the country.
Customs officers said the consignment could be part of an attempt to develop a "Balkan route" to smuggle drugs from the Middle East to western Europe.

A police spokesman said the hashish was hidden in a cargo of marble slabs driven from Greece in a Bulgarian- registered truck by a Bulgarian man. He did not give a figure for the value of the haul, seized on Saturday.
